posts.author: SoraFreedom
posts.body:
Hello RPH Maker forum, I'm Sora, and I'm pretty new and wholly inexperienced at the ways of game making, but I love learning new skills and, as I have written stories made over the years that I think could be fun little games, I have finally taken a dive into game creation and I hope to have a ton of fun with it.
I found RPG maker mv, and it looked intuitive and, so far, it has yet to really disappoint me in that regard. So a big thanks to the devs for this amazing program, and I hope to use it to the fullest of its capabilities in the years to come.

posts.author: EntangledPear
posts.body:
Welcome! Developing is great fun, and the sense of accomplishment when stuff works as you intended it to is wonderful
Good luck with your games and if you need any help, there are many people here who will give you advice, so ask away.
